properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256/512 everywhere: java-tron's own cryptohash implementation registered in TronCastleProvider, used for TRON/EVM address derivation (ECKey.java:783, ts address/index.ts:42/70), EIP-712/gasfree domain separators, CREATE2 digests, sunswap event topics, and the Web3 keystore MAC (ts keystore/index.ts:63). Grover-only exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt is THE password KDF: BouncyCastle SCrypt.generate in java-tron's keystore (Wallet, SKeyEncryptor) and Mnemonic encryption; @noble/hashes scrypt in the ts keystore writer/reader and CryptoEnvelope (every wallet blob at rest). Tests mock it with a cheap-scrypt shim but reference the real module.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 in the java keystore (the confusingly-named constant AES_128_CTR = "pbkdf2" in Wallet/SKeyEncryptor/Mnemonic marks accepted KDFs) and the ts V3 reader (pbkdf2-sha256 with file-supplied c capped at 10M). Project writes scrypt only, reads pbkdf2 for Java-importer parity.
